description: Expected results for the official DART Lorenz-63 example (models/lorenz_63/work, DART v11.21.2): perfect_model_obs then filter, 20-member EAKF, 600 obs. inputs/ are the unmodified files from the DART git tree. Recorded from a clean run of the server's built programs; two clean runs gave byte-identical obs_seq.out and obs_seq.final (deterministic).

numeric_checks.name: num_copies_final

recorded_with: perfect_model_obs + filter from /home/server/knowledge-dissection-toolkit/auto_dissect/_work/DART/source/repo/models/lorenz_63/work, run through the KI tools/run_dart.py
